This script reads in these data: FIS_pressure_groupings_Nov132026.csv

and converts them into pressure weights for the main groups that will be differentially affected by the pressures.


```{r setup, include=FALSE}

library(tidyverse)
library(here)

fis <- read_csv(here("FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/FIS_Scores_1.1/FIS_pressure_groupings_Nov132026.csv"))

head(fis)
table(fis$Major_Functional_Group)

fis <- fis %>%
  mutate(pressure_cat = case_when(
    Major_Functional_Group %in% c(
      "Anchovy & Sardine (small pelagics)", "Jellies"
    ) ~ "small_pelagic",
    Major_Functional_Group %in% c(
      "Pelagic marine fish (excl. anchovy & sardine)",
      "Cephalopods",
      "Marine fishes NEI"
    ) ~ "pelagics",
    Major_Functional_Group %in% c(
      "Demersal marine fishes",
      "Marine or freshwater fishes NEI"
    ) ~ "benthic_finfish",
    Major_Functional_Group == "Diadromous fishes" ~ "coastal_finfish",
    Major_Functional_Group == "Sharks" ~ "sharks",
    Major_Functional_Group == "Shrimps, prawns" ~ "shrimp",
    Major_Functional_Group == "Crustaceans" ~ "crustaceans",
    Major_Functional_Group %in% c(
      "Molluscs excl. Cephalopods",
      "Echinoderms",
      "Other marine invertebrates"
    ) ~ "shellfish",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))  


table(fis$pressure_cat)

# check NAs
fis %>%
  filter(is.na(pressure_cat)) %>%
  count(Major_Functional_Group, sort = TRUE)

fis <- fis %>%
  filter(!is.na(pressure_cat)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rgn_id)) %>%
  filter(year >= 2018) %>%
  group_by(pressure_cat, rgn_id) %>%
  summarize(tonnes = sum(FIS_weight_mt))

fis <- fis %>%
  group_by(rgn_id) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(tonnes)) %>%
  mutate(fis_weight = tonnes/total) %>%
  select(rgn_id, fis_category=pressure_cat, fis_weight)

write_csv(fis, here("FP/v2026/FP_Scores_1.1/FIS_Scores_1.1/FIS_pressure_weightings.csv"))

```
